Jaylen Brown is an NBA player.
Jaylen Brown's full name is Jaylen Marselles Brown.
Jaylen Brown was born on October 24, 1996.
Jaylen Brown plays for the Boston Celtics in the National Basketball Association (NBA).
Jaylen Brown played one year of college basketball at the University of California, Berkeley.
Jaylen Brown was a member of the California Golden Bears.
Jaylen Brown was named first-team all-conference and Freshman of the Year in the Pac-12 Conference during his freshman season.
Jaylen Brown declared for the 2016 NBA draft after his freshman year.
The Boston Celtics selected Jaylen Brown with the third overall pick in the 2016 NBA draft.
As a professional, Jaylen Brown has played as both shooting guard and small forward.
Jaylen Brown is a three-time NBA All-Star.
Jaylen Brown reached the Eastern Conference finals six times with the Boston Celtics.
Jaylen Brown helped the Boston Celtics reach the 2022 and 2024 NBA Finals.
Jaylen Brown won a championship in the 2022 NBA Finals.
Jaylen Brown was named Finals MVP in the 2024 NBA Finals.
Jaylen Brown played for Wheeler High School in Marietta, Georgia.
As a junior at Wheeler High School, Jaylen Brown averaged 24.1 points per game.
As a junior at Wheeler High School, Jaylen Brown averaged 8.2 rebounds per game.
As a junior at Wheeler High School, Jaylen Brown averaged 4.1 assists per game.
As a junior at Wheeler High School, Jaylen Brown averaged 2.0 steals per game.
In his senior year at Wheeler High School, Jaylen Brown led the team to victory in the Georgia High School Association (GHSA) Class 6A State Championship.
With 0.6 seconds remaining, Jaylen Brown hit two free throws during the GHSA Class 6A State Championship game.
During his senior season at Wheeler High School, Jaylen Brown helped lead his team to a 76–70 victory over Harry Giles and Wesleyan Christian Academy with 28 points and 11 rebounds.
During his senior season at Wheeler High School, Jaylen Brown recorded 24 points and eight rebounds in a 61–40 victory over Malik Monk and Bentonville High School.
During his senior season at Wheeler High School, Jaylen Brown had 25 points, 12 rebounds, and six assists in a 75–65 victory over Ben Simmons and Montverde Academy.
During his senior season at Wheeler High School, Jaylen Brown scored 29 points against Huntington Prep.
As a senior at Wheeler High School, Jaylen Brown averaged 28 points per game.
As a senior at Wheeler High School, Jaylen Brown averaged 12 rebounds per game.
Jaylen Brown won the 2014 FIBA Americas Championship gold medal as part of the USA Basketball Men's U18 National Team.
Jaylen Brown was selected to play in the 2015 McDonald's All-American Boys Game.
At the end of his high school career, Jaylen Brown was named Gatorade Georgia Boys Player of the Year.
At the end of his high school career, Jaylen Brown was named USA Today's All-USA Georgia Player of the Year.
At the end of his high school career, Jaylen Brown was named Georgia's Mr. Basketball.
At the end of his high school career, Jaylen Brown was named the Class 6A Player of the Year.
Jaylen Brown was rated a five-star recruit by Scout, ESPN, and 247Sports.
Rivals ranked Jaylen Brown third in his class.
On May 1, 2015, Jaylen Brown committed to play for the Golden Bears at the University of California, Berkeley.
Jaylen Brown played under coach Cuonzo Martin at the University of California, Berkeley.
Jaylen Brown was heralded as an all-around prospect due to his athleticism.
During his first semester in college, Jaylen Brown took a masters-level class in Berkeley's Cultural Studies of Sport in Education program.
While playing for the Golden Bears in 2015–16, Jaylen Brown averaged 14.6 points per game.
While playing for the Golden Bears in 2015–16, Jaylen Brown averaged 5.4 rebounds per game.
While playing for the Golden Bears in 2015–16, Jaylen Brown averaged 2.0 assists per game.
During his first semester in college, Jaylen Brown gained some fluency in Spanish.
Jaylen Brown stated a goal of learning three more languages by the age of 25.
During his freshman season at the University of California, Berkeley, Jaylen Brown had his best scoring games on November 27, 2015, against Richmond and January 27, 2016, against Utah.
On November 23, 2015, during a game against Sam Houston State, Jaylen Brown recorded 11 rebounds.
During the 2015–16 season, Jaylen Brown had his best rebounding games on January 1, 2016, against Colorado and November 23, 2015, against Sam Houston State.
On January 23, 2016, during a game against Arizona, Jaylen Brown recorded seven assists to go along with 15 points in a narrow victory.
During the 2015–16 season, Jaylen Brown earned first-team All-Pac-12 honors and was named Pac-12 Freshman of the Year.
On June 23, 2016, Jaylen Brown was selected by the Boston Celtics with the third overall pick in the 2016 NBA draft.
On July 27, 2016, Jaylen Brown signed his rookie scale contract with the Celtics after averaging 16.0 points, 6.2 rebounds, and 2.3 steals in six Summer League games.
Jaylen Brown made his debut for the Celtics on October 26, 2016, scoring nine points against the Brooklyn Nets.
On November 3, 2016, Jaylen Brown scored 19 points during a loss to the Cleveland Cavaliers.
On January 27, 2017, Jaylen Brown recorded his career-high of 20 points in a victory over the Orlando Magic.
During the 2016–17 season, Jaylen Brown averaged 17.2 minutes on the floor.
During the 2016–17 season, Jaylen Brown averaged 6.6 points per game.
During the 2016–17 season, Jaylen Brown averaged 2.8 rebounds per game.
During the 2016–17 season, Jaylen Brown averaged 0.8 assists per game in 78 games and 20 starts.
Jaylen Brown was named to the NBA All-Rookie Second Team at the end of the 2016–17 season.
The Boston Celtics drafted Jayson Tatum third overall in the 2017 NBA draft.
On October 17, 2017, Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum made their debut together in a loss to the Cleveland Cavaliers.
On November 18, 2017, Jaylen Brown had his career-high of 27 points during a victory over the Atlanta Hawks.
On December 13, 2017, Jaylen Brown scored 26 points against the Denver Nuggets.
Jaylen Brown missed two weeks in March 2018 due to a concussion.
On April 6, 2018, Jaylen Brown set his career-high of 32 points during a victory over the Chicago Bulls.
In Game 2 of the Celtics' first-round playoff series against the Milwaukee Bucks on April 17, 2018, Jaylen Brown had his career-high in playoffs with 30 points.
Five days later in Game 4, Jaylen Brown set a new playoff career-high and scored a career-high 34 points during a narrow loss to the Bucks.
The Boston Celtics won the series against the Milwaukee Bucks in seven games.
Jaylen Brown sat out of Game 1 of the Eastern Conference Semifinals against the Philadelphia 76ers due to a strained hamstring.
On May 3, 2018, Jaylen Brown scored 24 points during a victory over the Philadelphia 76ers.
On May 25, 2018, Jaylen Brown recorded his career-high of 27 points in a loss to the Cavaliers.
The Boston Celtics lost the series against the Miami Heat in seven games.
Jaylen Brown struggled to start the season and was criticized for taking too many two-point jump shots.
After the Celtics started the season with an unexpected 10–10 record, Jackie MacMullan wrote that "nobody disappointed [the Celtics] more than Jaylen Brown."
On December 6, 2018, Jaylen Brown returned after missing three games and scored 21 points during a victory over the New York Knicks.
Two days later, on December 8, 2018, Jaylen Brown scored a game-high of 23 points during a blowout victory over the Chicago Bulls.
On December 31, 2018, Jaylen Brown recorded his season-high of 30 points in a loss to the San Antonio Spurs.
In October 2019, Jaylen Brown signed a four-year, $115 million contract extension with the Celtics.
On December 28, 2019, Jaylen Brown tied his career-high of 34 points during a victory over the Cleveland Cavaliers.
In January 2020, Jaylen Brown narrowly missed being selected to the 2020 NBA All-Star Game.
During the 2019–20 season playoffs, the Boston Celtics advanced to the Eastern Conference Finals for the third time in four years.
On December 30, 2020, Jaylen Brown recorded his career-high of 42 points during a victory over the Memphis Grizzlies.
On February 24, 2021, Jaylen Brown was selected as an NBA All-Star reserve for the first time.
On April 15, 2021, Jaylen Brown scored 40 points in a victory over the Los Angeles Lakers.
Jaylen Brown underwent wrist surgery on April 6, 2021, due to a torn scapholunate ligament in his left wrist.
On October 20, 2021, Jaylen Brown recorded his career-high of 46 points during a double overtime loss to the New York Knicks.
On January 2, 2022, Jaylen Brown scored 50 points and grabbed 11 rebounds in an overtime victory over the Orlando Magic.
Six days later against the Knicks on January 8, 2022, Jaylen Brown recorded his first career triple-double with 22 points, 11 rebounds, and 11 assists during a blowout victory.
On March 18, 2022, Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum each scored at least 30 points in the same game for the fourth time that season.
Two days later on March 20, 2022, Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum broke the record by both scoring 30 points with over 60% shooting from the field.

On May 3, 2022, during Game 2 of the Eastern Conference Semifinals, Jaylen Brown scored 25 of his 30 points in the first half and recorded six rebounds, six assists, and two steals during a victory over the Milwaukee Bucks.
Four days later on May 7, 2022, Jaylen Brown posted 27 points, 12 rebounds, and four assists during a narrow loss to the Milwaukee Bucks.
On May 21, 2022, in Game 3 of the Eastern Conference Finals, Jaylen Brown scored his playoff career-high of 40 points on 14-of-20 shooting from the field during a loss to the Miami Heat.
Eight days later on May 29, 2022, Jaylen Brown had 24 points, six rebounds, and six assists in a victory over the Miami Heat.
During Game 1 of the 2022 NBA Finals on June 2, 2022, Jaylen Brown posted 24 points, seven rebounds, and five assists during a comeback victory over the Golden State Warriors.
Six days later on June 8, 2022, Jaylen Brown recorded 27 points, nine rebounds, and five assists in a victory to take a 2–1 series lead.
The Boston Celtics lost the 2022 NBA Finals in six games despite Jaylen Brown's 34-point outing in Game 6 on June 16, 2022.
On December 2, 2022, Jaylen Brown recorded 37 points and 14 rebounds during a double overtime loss to the Miami Heat.
He sent the game to overtime by making a long three-pointer with 1.7 seconds left in regulation on December 2, 2022.
On December 13, 2022, Jaylen Brown posted 25 points and a season-high of 15 rebounds during an overtime victory over the Los Angeles Lakers.
On December 25, 2022, Jaylen Brown scored 29 points and had five rebounds in a victory over the Milwaukee Bucks.
Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum combined for 70 points in a game for the eighth time in their careers on December 25, 2022.
On January 11, 2023, Jaylen Brown scored his season-high of 41 points during a victory over the New Orleans Pelicans.
It was the fifth 40-point game in Jaylen Brown's career and the 10th time that he and Jayson Tatum combined to score 70+ points on January 11, 2023.
The Celtics were undefeated in those games.
On February 2, 2023, Jaylen Brown was named as an Eastern Conference reserve for the 2023 NBA All-Star Game.
On March 6, 2023, Jaylen Brown posted a near triple-double with 32 points, 13 rebounds, and nine assists during a loss to the Cleveland Cavaliers.
On March 13, 2023, Jaylen Brown scored his season-high of 43 points in a narrow loss to the Houston Rockets.
On March 26, 2023, Jaylen Brown recorded 41 points and 13 rebounds during a victory over the San Antonio Spurs.
On April 15, 2023, during Game 1 of the Eastern Conference first round against the Atlanta Hawks, Jaylen Brown had 29 points and 12 rebounds in a victory.
Eight days later on April 23, 2023, Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown both scored 31 points as the Celtics defeated the Hawks.
During the second quarter of Game 4, Jaylen Brown took off his protective mask he had worn since February due to a stray elbow from Jayson Tatum on April 23, 2023.
On May 5, 2023, during Game 3 of the Eastern Conference semifinals against the Philadelphia 76ers, Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum combined for 50 points in a victory.
The Boston Celtics reached the Eastern Conference Finals but lost to the Miami Heat in seven games on June 14, 2023.
On July 25, 2023, Jaylen Brown signed a five-year contract extension worth up to $304 million with the Boston Celtics.
Jaylen Brown became eligible for the five-year "supermax" extension after making second-team All-NBA during the 2022–23 season.
On January 22, 2024, Jaylen Brown recorded his third career triple-double with 13 points, 11 rebounds, and 10 assists in a victory over the Houston Rockets.
On February 1, 2024, Jaylen Brown was named as an Eastern Conference reserve for the 2024 NBA All-Star Game.
On March 7, 2024, Jaylen Brown scored his season-high of 41 points and grabbed 14 rebounds during a loss to the Denver Nuggets.
Later that month on March 15, 2024, Jaylen Brown stated he believed this was his best season in his career.
On April 7, 2024, Jaylen Brown scored 26 points as the Celtics achieved their 10,000th career point.
Brown is primarily a vegetarian and has interests including Spanish language, history, meditation, philosophy, soccer, and anime.
Many have described Jaylen Brown as an unusual athlete with many ambitions beyond basketball.
Jaylen Brown's father, Marselles, is a professional boxer who is the 2016 WBU World Champion and the 2015 WBU C.A.M. Heavyweight Champion.
Jaylen Brown's grandfather, Willie Brown, is also a former boxer.
Jaylen Brown is the cousin of former professional football cornerback A. J. Bouye.
In June 2024, Jaylen Brown performed an Umrah pilgrimage in the form of a religious journey to Mecca.
On January 22, 2024, Jaylen Brown was accompanied by WNBA player Kysre Gondrezick during the Celtics' championship parade and later to the ESPY Awards.
At the ESPY Awards, Jaylen Brown described Kysre Gondrezick as "my date."
Jaylen Brown is a practicing Muslim who converted in 2021.
